rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Independently recounted every `**...**` span this session with `grep -nE '\*\*[^*]+\*\*' wpi-body.txt` and an awk per-chunk tally: chunk1("One session, plotted")=1 line200 "A check is a position fix"; chunk2("Reference and plan")=2, line211 "Reference artefact" + line212 "plan.md"; chunk3=1 line216 "External verifier"; chunk4=1 line225 "candidates"; chunk5=1 line230 "A prediction is not a measurement."; chunk6=1 line237 "The engineer decides"; chunk7=1 line242 "hook"; chunk8=1 line247 "Must happen goes in a hook"; chunk9=0. All within the <=1-per-slide budget except chunk 2's 2, which fits the rule's own "a law/consolidation slide may carry one handle per law" exception — Reference artefact and plan.md are two distinct named pieces of the kit, one handle each, no doubling on one bullet. Three spans (chunk1 "A check is a position fix", chunk5 "A prediction is not a measurement", chunk8 "Must happen goes in a hook") are six-word bolded clauses, past the rule's literal <=5-word handle-span guidance. Weighing the harm the rule guards against (a bullet-lead-bold monoculture where nothing is distinguished) against what is actually here: each is the SOLE bold in an otherwise-plain chunk (1-2 unbolded bullets sit beside each, so nothing is being drowned out); each is tracked as a named "vision" claim in this file's own backing ledger (`check-is-a-position-fix`, `prediction-not-measurement`, `must-happen-goes-in-a-hook`) — i.e., a coined law/principle, the rule's own allowed category — not incidental sentence emphasis; and the chunk-5 span sits inside the theory passage the maintainer block marks "wording Antti-blessed 2026-08-14/15" with an explicit instruction not to move or alter it, so trimming it to a sub-span would edit hand-approved text for a marginal format nit. The monoculture harm is absent. Not filing a REVISE; carrying forward the same rule-question the prior slides pass raised (a whole-clause bold for a backing-tracked coined maxim, one per slide, reads as inside the handle allowance) since nothing in this pass changes that reasoning.
